name: Starlight Princess 1000

features.name: Tumble wins
features.description: Winning symbols disappear and new ones fall into place, with no limit on consecutive tumbles.

features.name: 2x–1,000x multipliers
features.description: Multiplier symbols combine at the end of each tumble sequence and multiply its total win.

features.name: Free spins
features.description: Four or more princess scatters trigger the bonus, where multipliers are collected into a total for the round.

review:
The anime pay-anywhere game with its multipliers stretched. Eight matching gems or charms anywhere on the 6x5 grid win and tumble, with no limit on chains.

Multipliers from 2x up to 1,000x can land in the base game and bonus, adding up at the end of each sequence. Four princess scatters trigger free spins with a running multiplier total. Up to 5,000x, 96.5% RTP. Plays almost the same as Gates of Olympus 1000 – pick your favourite theme.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
